source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Land Use Statistics at a Glance, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 57: cropping intensity, per cent (area sown with crops, counting each crop, as a percentage of the net sown area).
